verdicts.reason: A breaks the product apart: the sage circle sits alone at the far left while the can is pushed to the far right, so you get two leftover fragments with empty space on both sides of the text. The body copy is also unreadably small and the SOLSTICE wordmark now sits under the headline. B makes the same text mistakes: the wordmark is under the headline, the body copy is tiny, and the CTA is crammed in among the badges. B's circle is also cut off at the left edge and the can sits beside it rather than on it. But B keeps the product on the left and the copy on the right, so it reads left to right like a banner and is the less broken of the two.
